# اِسْتَذْكَرْتِ (istaḏkarti) /is.tað.kar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَذْكَرَ (istaḏkara)
# اِسْتَذْكَرَتْ (istaḏkarat) /is.t
